name: school_promotion
summary: Automated grade promotion/retention batches and bulk student Excel import
description: Academic progression and data-entry utilities for the school system: promotion batches record per-student pass/fail decisions and roll students to the next grade or repeat the same grade for a new academic year; import batches stage large sets of student rows (.xlsx/.csv) with duplicate/error detection before they are applied to enrollment. Running promotion is a Manager privilege.
author: Nexa
